snapshot.title: Update rough earnings from mining in the early game
snapshot.description: In the early game, as long as the user mines the maximum amount they can from a target (based on the strength of the mining laser (how much it can extract) and the capacity), they should net around 115% of the original price of the rocket, as long as they also salvage/scrap the rocket too at the end of the mission.

changes.newValue:
1. Centralize rocket balance inputs (cost, speed/range multipliers, mining/cargo multipliers) in a shared config utility.
2. Tune early-game economy so full mining + scrap on Starter Rocket 1 yields roughly 115% of rocket price.
3. Add/adjust tests for payout and mining/output scaling to lock expected economics.
